# Overview

This document details the complete data processing pipeline for **Core Body Temperature (CBT)** measurements from ingestible telemetric pills (BodyCap e-Celsius) used in the AfterGlow study.

## Study Context

Measurement Device: BodyCap e-Celsius ingestible temperature pills\
Measurement Frequency: 1-minute intervals\
Recording Period: In-Laboratory phase\
Participants: 9 total (P01-P07, P09-P10; P11 excluded due to dropout)\

## Key Data Challenges

This dataset presented several challenges requiring specialized processing:

1.  Metadata Transcription Errors: Handwritten pill IDs containing hexadecimal characters (0-9, A-F) led to multiple transcription ambiguities
2.  File Dating Issues: Incorrect file dates requiring manual correction
3.  Date Format Inconsistencies: Mixed US/EU date formats within files
4.  Corrupted Timestamps: Battery degradation causing "INVALID DATE AND TIME" entries requiring reconstruction
5.  Session Exclusions: P10 Session 405 excluded due to light automation malfunction

## Processing Strategy

All issues were resolved using a systematic approach:

-   Process-of-elimination methodology for severe metadata errors
-   Temperature jump detection for timestamp reconstruction
-   Machine-readable ID verification from raw data files
-   Cross-validation across consecutive sessions
-   Comprehensive documentation of all corrections

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Core Processing Functions

## Function: Find Pill Position

This function locates the correct pill within multi-pill recording files by matching the pill ID.

```{r function-find-pill}
# Function: Find pill position
find_pill_position <- function(file_path, target_cbt_id) {
  pill_line <- read_lines(file_path, skip = 4, n_max = 1, locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"))
  pill_parts <- strsplit(pill_line, ",")[[1]]
  pill_ids <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:length(pill_parts)) {
    if(grepl("^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\\.[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\\.[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\\.[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$", pill_parts[i])) {
      pill_ids <- c(pill_ids, pill_parts[i])
    }
  }
  
  match_idx <- which(pill_ids == target_cbt_id)
  return(list(
    found = length(match_idx) > 0, 
    position = ifelse(length(match_idx) > 0, match_idx, NA), 
    pill_ids = pill_ids
  ))
}
```

## Function: Standard Processing

This is the primary processing function for sessions without special issues.

```{r function-standard}
# Function: Standard processing
process_session <- function(participant_id, session, date, cbt_id, start_time, end_time) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s Session %d ===\n", participant_id, session))
  session_num <- session %% 100
  
  file_time <- case_when(
    participant_id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ "233000",
    participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ "213000",
    participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ "230000",
    participant_id == "P10" ~ "223000"
  )
  
  file_path <- sprintf("C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/%s/%02d_expsession/cbt/01_cbt_%sT%s.csv",
                       participant_id, session_num, format(date, "%Y%m%d"), file_time)
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)
  
  pill_info <- find_pill_position(file_path, cbt_id)
  if (!pill_info$found) return(NULL)
  
  start_col <- (pill_info$position - 1) * 7 + 1
  end_col <- start_col + 6
  
  data <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 5, locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"), 
                   col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  data_pill <- data[, start_col:end_col] %>% clean_names()
  
  col_names_list <- names(data_pill)
  
  data_clean <- data_pill %>%
    select(all_of(c(col_names_list[2], col_names_list[3], col_names_list[4]))) %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = dmy_hms(paste(.data[[col_names_list[2]]], .data[[col_names_list[3]]])),
      timestamp = format(datetime, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    ) %>%
    rename(cbt = !!col_names_list[4]) %>%
    select(timestamp, cbt)
  
  start_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", start_time, ":00"))
  end_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", end_time, ":00"))
  
  data_filtered <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%
    filter(datetime >= start_datetime & datetime <= end_datetime) %>%
    select(-datetime)
  
  data_final <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(id = participant_id, session = as.character(session)) %>%
    select(timestamp, id, session, cbt)
  
  cat(sprintf("Rows: %d\n", nrow(data_final)))
  return(data_final)
}
```

# Special Processing Functions

## P06-Specific Processing

**Issues Addressed:**

1.  **Session 310**: File dated 2025-08-10 instead of correct date 2025-08-06
2.  **Session 304**: US date format (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of EU format (dd/mm/yyyy)

**Solution:** Auto-detect date format from column headers and override file date when needed.

```{r function-p06}
# Function: P06-specific processing
# PROBLEM 1: Session 310 file dated 2025-08-10 instead of 2025-08-06
# PROBLEM 2: Session 304 uses US date format (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of EU format
# SOLUTION: Override file date for 310, auto-detect date format from column name
process_session_p06 <- function(participant_id, session, date, cbt_id, start_time, end_time) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s Session %d ===\n", participant_id, session))
  session_num <- session %% 100
  
  # Special handling for Session 310
  if (participant_id == "P06" && session == 310) {
    file_date <- as.Date("2025-08-10")
    cat("NOTE: Using corrected file date (2025-08-10)\n")
  } else {
    file_date <- date
  }
  
  file_time <- "230000"
  
  file_path <- sprintf("C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/%s/%02d_expsession/cbt/01_cbt_%sT%s.csv",
                       participant_id, session_num, format(file_date, "%Y%m%d"), file_time)
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)
  
  pill_info <- find_pill_position(file_path, cbt_id)
  if (!pill_info$found) return(NULL)
  
  start_col <- (pill_info$position - 1) * 7 + 1
  end_col <- start_col + 6
  
  data <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 5, locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"),
                   col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  data_pill <- data[, start_col:end_col] %>% clean_names()
  
  col_names_list <- names(data_pill)
  date_col <- col_names_list[2]
  hour_col <- col_names_list[3]
  temp_col <- col_names_list[4]
  
  # Auto-detect date format
  if (grepl("mm_dd", date_col, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    cat("Detected US date format\n")
    data_clean <- data_pill %>%
      select(all_of(c(date_col, hour_col, temp_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        datetime = mdy_hms(paste(.data[[date_col]], .data[[hour_col]])),
        timestamp = format(datetime, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
      ) %>%
      rename(cbt = !!temp_col) %>%
      select(timestamp, cbt)
  } else {
    data_clean <- data_pill %>%
      select(all_of(c(date_col, hour_col, temp_col))) %>%
      mutate(
        datetime = dmy_hms(paste(.data[[date_col]], .data[[hour_col]])),
        timestamp = format(datetime, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
      ) %>%
      rename(cbt = !!temp_col) %>%
      select(timestamp, cbt)
  }
  
  start_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", start_time, ":00"))
  end_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", end_time, ":00"))
  
  data_filtered <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%
    filter(datetime >= start_datetime & datetime <= end_datetime) %>%
    select(-datetime)
  
  data_final <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(id = participant_id, session = as.character(session)) %>%
    select(timestamp, id, session, cbt)
  
  cat(sprintf("Rows: %d\n", nrow(data_final)))
  return(data_final)
}
```

## P07 Timestamp Reconstruction

**Problem:** Sessions 304-309 contain corrupted timestamps showing "INVALID DATE AND TIME"\
**Cause:** BodyCap pill battery degradation during later recording sessions\
**Solution:** Reconstruct timestamps using physiological temperature signatures

### Methodology

1.  **Temperature Jump Detection**: Body temperature rises sharply (\>5°C) upon pill ingestion
2.  **Timeline Anchoring**: Use documented ingestion time from metadata
3.  **Interval Assumption**: Pills record at 1-minute intervals
4.  **Validation**: Verify reconstructed timestamps align with session windows

```{r function-p07}
# Function: P07 timestamp reconstruction
# PROBLEM: Sessions 304-309 have corrupted timestamps ("INVALID DATE AND TIME")
# CAUSE: BodyCap pill battery degradation
# SOLUTION: Reconstruct timestamps using temperature jump detection
#   - Temperature rises sharply (>5°C) at ingestion
#   - Anchor timeline to documented ingestion time
#   - Measurements at 1-minute intervals
process_session_p07_broken_timestamps <- function(participant_id, session, date, cbt_id, 
                                                  start_time, end_time, ingestion_time) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s Session %d (TIMESTAMP RECONSTRUCTION) ===\n", participant_id, session))
  session_num <- session %% 100
  file_time <- "230000"
  
  file_path <- sprintf("C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/%s/%02d_expsession/cbt/01_cbt_%sT%s.csv",
                       participant_id, session_num, format(date, "%Y%m%d"), file_time)
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)
  
  pill_info <- find_pill_position(file_path, cbt_id)
  if (!pill_info$found) return(NULL)
  
  start_col <- (pill_info$position - 1) * 7 + 1
  end_col <- start_col + 6
  
  data <- read_csv(file_path, skip = 5, locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"),
                   col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  data_pill <- data[, start_col:end_col] %>% clean_names()
  
  col_names_list <- names(data_pill)
  temp_col <- col_names_list[4]
  temps <- data_pill[[temp_col]]
  
  # Detect ingestion via temperature jump
  temp_diffs <- diff(temps)
  big_jumps <- which(temp_diffs > 5)
  
  if (length(big_jumps) == 0) {
    big_jumps <- which(temp_diffs > 3)
    if (length(big_jumps) == 0) {
      ingestion_row <- 1
    } else {
      ingestion_row <- big_jumps[1] + 1
      cat(sprintf("Temp jump: %.1f°C at row %d\n", temp_diffs[big_jumps[1]], ingestion_row))
    }
  } else {
    ingestion_row <- big_jumps[1] + 1
    cat(sprintf("Temp jump: %.1f°C at row %d\n", temp_diffs[big_jumps[1]], ingestion_row))
  }
  
  # Reconstruct timestamps
  ingestion_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", ingestion_time, ":00"))
  
  data_corrected <- data_pill %>%
    mutate(
      row_num = row_number(),
      minutes_from_ingestion = row_num - ingestion_row,
      datetime = ingestion_datetime + minutes(minutes_from_ingestion),
      timestamp = format(datetime, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    ) %>%
    rename(cbt = !!temp_col) %>%
    select(timestamp, cbt)
  
  start_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", start_time, ":00"))
  end_datetime <- ymd_hms(paste0(format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "T", end_time, ":00"))
  
  data_filtered <- data_corrected %>%
    mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%
    filter(datetime >= start_datetime & datetime <= end_datetime) %>%
    select(-datetime)
  
  data_final <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(id = participant_id, session = as.character(session)) %>%
    select(timestamp, id, session, cbt)
  
  cat(sprintf("Rows: %d\n", nrow(data_final)))
  return(data_final)
}
```

# Processing Clean Participants

These participants had no data quality issues requiring special handling.

```{r process-clean}
# Helper function
process_participant_standard <- function(participant_id, session_times, group_digit) {
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Processing %s ===\n", participant_id))
  
  metadata_participant <- metadata_raw %>%
    filter(participant_id == !!participant_id) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      session = group_digit * 100 + row_number(),
      cbt_id = str_replace(cbt_id, ",", ".")
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, date, cbt_id, session) %>%
    left_join(session_times, by = c("participant_id", "session"))
  
  all_sessions <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(metadata_participant)) {
    row <- metadata_participant[i, ]
    
    session_data <- tryCatch({
      process_session(
        participant_id = row$participant_id,
        session = row$session,
        date = row$date,
        cbt_id = row$cbt_id,
        start_time = row$start_time,
        end_time = row$end_time
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Error in %s session %d: %s", participant_id, row$session, e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(session_data)) {
      all_sessions[[i]] <- session_data
    }
  }
  
  result <- bind_rows(all_sessions)
  cat(sprintf("✓ %s: %d sessions, %d rows\n", participant_id, 
              length(unique(result$session)), nrow(result)))
  
  return(result)
}
```

## P10 with Session 405 Exclusion

**Exclusion Reason:** Light automation malfunction during Session 405

```{r process-p10, results='hide'}
# P10 with Session 405 exclusion
metadata_P10 <- metadata_raw %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P10") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    session = 400 + row_number(),
    cbt_id = str_replace(cbt_id, ",", ".")
  ) %>%
  select(participant_id, date, cbt_id, session) %>%
  left_join(P10_times, by = c("participant_id", "session"))

all_sessions_P10 <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(metadata_P10)) {
  row <- metadata_P10[i, ]
  
  if (row$session == 405) {
    cat("Skipping Session 405 (light automation malfunction)\n")
    next
  }
  
  session_data <- tryCatch({
    process_session(
      participant_id = row$participant_id,
      session = row$session,
      date = row$date,
      cbt_id = row$cbt_id,
      start_time = row$start_time,
      end_time = row$end_time
    )
  }, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })
  
  if (!is.null(session_data)) {
    all_sessions_P10[[i]] <- session_data
  }
}

cbt <- bind_rows(cbt, bind_rows(all_sessions_P10))
cat(sprintf("✓ P10: %d sessions\n", length(unique(bind_rows(all_sessions_P10)$session))))
```

## P07 Processing

### Extract Ingestion Times

```{r p07-ingestion}
# P07 Processing
metadata_ingestion <- read_excel(metadata_file, col_types = "text") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(as.numeric(date), origin = "1899-12-30"))

P07_ingestion_times <- metadata_ingestion %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P07") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    session = 300 + row_number(),
    ingestion_decimal = as.numeric(cbt_ingestion_time),
    ingestion_hours = floor(ingestion_decimal * 24),
    ingestion_minutes = round((ingestion_decimal * 24 - ingestion_hours) * 60),
    ingestion_time = sprintf("%02d:%02d", ingestion_hours, ingestion_minutes)
  ) %>%
  select(session, ingestion_time)

cat("Temperature dynamics validation (from Session 301):\n")
cat("  - Baseline: ~21°C, Jump: 7.7°C at ingestion, Threshold: >5°C\n")
cat("  - This validates using temperature jumps for timestamp reconstruction\n")
```

### Process P07 Sessions

```{r p07-sessions, results='hide'}
P07_times <- tibble(
  participant_id = rep("P07", 10), session = 301:310,
  start_time = rep("18:00", 10),
  end_time = c("23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01", "23:01")
)

metadata_P07 <- metadata_raw %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P07") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    session = 300 + row_number(),
    cbt_id = str_replace(cbt_id, ",", ".")
  ) %>%
  select(participant_id, date, cbt_id, session) %>%
  left_join(P07_times, by = c("participant_id", "session")) %>%
  left_join(P07_ingestion_times, by = "session")

broken_timestamp_sessions <- c(304, 305, 306, 307, 308, 309)
all_sessions_P07 <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(metadata_P07)) {
  row <- metadata_P07[i, ]
  
  if (row$session %in% broken_timestamp_sessions) {
    session_data <- tryCatch({
      process_session_p07_broken_timestamps(
        participant_id = row$participant_id,
        session = row$session,
        date = row$date,
        cbt_id = row$cbt_id,
        start_time = row$start_time,
        end_time = row$end_time,
        ingestion_time = row$ingestion_time
      )
    }, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })
  } else {
    session_data <- tryCatch({
      process_session(
        participant_id = row$participant_id,
        session = row$session,
        date = row$date,
        cbt_id = row$cbt_id,
        start_time = row$start_time,
        end_time = row$end_time
      )
    }, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })
  }
  
  if (!is.null(session_data)) {
    all_sessions_P07[[i]] <- session_data
  }
}

cbt <- bind_rows(cbt, bind_rows(all_sessions_P07))
cat(sprintf("✓ P07: %d sessions\n", length(unique(bind_rows(all_sessions_P07)$session))))
```

# Transcription Error Corrections

This section corrects metadata transcription errors where handwritten hexadecimal characters were misread. All corrections were validated against machine-readable pill IDs in raw data files.

## Common Transcription Patterns

| **Metadata Error** | **Actual Value** | **Character Confusion** |
|:-------------------|:-----------------|:------------------------|
| '4' → 'A'          | Hexadecimal A    | Handwriting similarity  |
| '1' → 'A'          | Hexadecimal A    | Similar appearance      |
| '0' → 'D'          | Hexadecimal D    | Rounded writing         |
| '7' → 'F'          | Hexadecimal F    | Angular similarity      |
| '7' → 'T'          | Digit 7          | Crossed seven style     |
| 'O' → '0'          | Digit 0          | Letter vs. number       |

## Individual Corrections

# Severe Metadata Issues

These corrections required process-of-elimination methodology by comparing pills across consecutive sessions to identify the correct pill for each session. - Compare pills across consecutive sessions - Identify newly ingested pill (not present in previous session - Validate: pill persists in following session (1-2 day transit)

## P01 Session 104

**Problem:** Metadata 24.00.70.2C not found in any Group 1 file\
**Cause:** Metadata swap between P01 and P03 for Session 104

**Process-of-Elimination:**

-   Session 103 pills: 24.00.72.0F, 24.00.72.0D, 24.00.77.56
-   Session 104 pills: 24.00.72.6E, 24.00.72.0D, 24.00.77.56
-   Session 105 pills: 24.00.72.6E, 24.00.72.48, 24.00.77.56
-   **NEW in 104:** 24.00.72.6E (only pill not in 103)
-   **Validated:** 24.00.72.6E appears in 105 ✓

```{r p01-104, results='hide'}
# P01 Session 104
# PROBLEM: Metadata 24.00.70.2C not found in any Group 1 file
# CAUSE: Metadata swap between P01 and P03 for Session 104
# SOLUTION: Process-of-elimination
#   - Session 103: 24.00.72.0F, 24.00.72.0D, 24.00.77.56
#   - Session 104: 24.00.72.6E, 24.00.72.0D, 24.00.77.56
#   - Session 105: 24.00.72.6E, 24.00.72.48, 24.00.77.56
#   - NEW in 104: 24.00.72.6E (only pill not in 103)
#   - Validated: 24.00.72.6E appears in 105 ✓
# Metadata: 24.00.70.2C (not found)
# Elimination result: 24.00.72.6E (validated in Session 105)

P01_104 <- tryCatch({
  process_session("P01", 104, as.Date("2025-06-19"), "24.00.72.6E", "18:30", "23:32")
}, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })

if (!is.null(P01_104)) {
  cbt <- bind_rows(cbt, P01_104)
  cat("✓ Added\n")
}
```

## P03 Session 104

**Problem:** Metadata 24.00.72.6E actually belongs to P01 Session 104\
**Cause:** Metadata swap between P01 and P03

-   P01 metadata (24.00.70.2C) resembles P03 file pill (24.00.76.2C)
-   P03 metadata (24.00.72.6E) matches P01 file pill exactly

**Process-of-Elimination:**

-   Session 103 pills: 24.00.73.6B, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.6E.EE
-   Session 104 pills: 24.00.76.2C, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.6E.EE
-   Session 105 pills: 24.00.76.2C, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.72.A4
-   **NEW in 104:** 24.00.76.2C (only pill not in 103)
-   **Validated:** 24.00.76.2C appears in 105 ✓

```{r p03-104, results='hide'}
# P03 Session 104
# PROBLEM: Metadata 24.00.72.6E actually belongs to P01 Session 104
# CAUSE: Metadata swap between P01 and P03
#   - P01 metadata (24.00.70.2C) resembles P03 file pill (24.00.76.2C)
#   - P03 metadata (24.00.72.6E) matches P01 file pill exactly
# SOLUTION: Process-of-elimination
#   - Session 103: 24.00.73.6B, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.6E.EE
#   - Session 104: 24.00.76.2C, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.6E.EE
#   - Session 105: 24.00.76.2C, 24.00.70.2D, 24.00.72.A4
#   - NEW in 104: 24.00.76.2C (only pill not in 103)
#   - Validated: 24.00.76.2C appears in 105 ✓
# Metadata: 24.00.72.6E (actually P01's pill)
# Elimination result: 24.00.76.2C (validated in Session 105)

P03_104 <- tryCatch({
  process_session("P03", 104, as.Date("2025-06-19"), "24.00.76.2C", "18:30", "23:41")
}, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })

if (!is.null(P03_104)) {
  cbt <- bind_rows(cbt, P03_104)
  cat("✓ Added\n")
}
```

## Data Completeness Validation

```{r completeness}
# Completeness validation
expected_sessions <- list(
  P01 = as.character(101:111),
  P02 = as.character(101:111),
  P03 = as.character(101:111),
  P04 = as.character(201:210),
  P05 = as.character(201:210),
  P06 = as.character(301:310),
  P07 = as.character(301:310),
  P09 = as.character(301:310),
  P10 = as.character(c(401:404, 406:413))
)

completeness_results <- list()

for (participant in names(expected_sessions)) {
  expected <- expected_sessions[[participant]]
  actual <- cbt %>% 
    filter(id == participant) %>% 
    distinct(session) %>% 
    pull(session)
  
  missing <- setdiff(expected, actual)
  extra <- setdiff(actual, expected)
  
  status <- if(length(missing) == 0 && length(extra) == 0) "✓ COMPLETE" else "✗ INCOMPLETE"
  
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: %s\n", participant, status))
  cat(sprintf("  Expected: %d sessions\n", length(expected)))
  cat(sprintf("  Found:    %d sessions\n", length(actual)))
  
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  Missing:  %s\n", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  if (length(extra) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  Extra:    %s\n", paste(extra, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  completeness_results[[participant]] <- tibble(
    participant = participant,
    expected = length(expected),
    found = length(actual),
    missing_count = length(missing),
    complete = length(missing) == 0 && length(extra) == 0
  )
}

# Summary
completeness_df <- bind_rows(completeness_results)
total_expected <- sum(completeness_df$expected)
total_found <- sum(completeness_df$found)

cat("\n=== OVERALL SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total expected sessions: %d\n", total_expected))
cat(sprintf("Total found sessions:    %d\n", total_found))
cat(sprintf("Completeness rate:       %.1f%%\n", 100 * total_found / total_expected))

# Final verdict
unexpected <- setdiff(unique(cbt$id), names(expected_sessions))

if (total_found == total_expected && length(unexpected) == 0) {
  cat("\n✓✓✓ ALL EXPECTED DATA PRESENT ✓✓✓\n")
  cat("Dataset is complete and ready for analysis.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠ Data completeness issues detected - review above\n")
}
```

### Interactive Data Table per Participant and Session

```{r interactive-table}
# Create interactive table with all temperature data
cbt %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(substr(timestamp, 1, 8), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    time = paste0(substr(timestamp, 10, 11), ":", substr(timestamp, 12, 13), ":", substr(timestamp, 14, 15))
  ) %>%
  select(id, session, date, time, cbt) %>%
  datatable(
    filter = 'top',
    options = list(
      pageLength = 50,
      order = list(list(0, 'asc'), list(1, 'asc'), list(3, 'asc')),
      scrollX = TRUE
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = "Core Body Temperature - All Measurements (1-minute intervals)"
  ) %>%
  formatRound('cbt', 2)
```

### Round Timestamps to Full Minutes (remove seconds)

```{r round-timestamps}
# Count before
n_before <- nrow(cbt)

# Round timestamps to full minutes by removing seconds
cbt <- cbt %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract components
    date_part = substr(timestamp, 1, 8),      # YYYYMMDD
    hour = substr(timestamp, 10, 11),          # HH
    minute = substr(timestamp, 12, 13),        # MM
    # Reconstruct timestamp without seconds (set to 00)
    timestamp = paste0(date_part, "T", hour, minute, "00")
  ) %>%
  # Remove potential duplicates created by rounding
  distinct(id, session, timestamp, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Count after
n_after <- nrow(cbt)
n_removed <- n_before - n_after

# Summary
data.frame(
  Metric = c("Measurements before", "Duplicates removed", "Measurements after"),
  Value = c(
    format(n_before, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_removed, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_after, big.mark = ",")
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Timestamp Rounding: Seconds Removed and Duplicates Eliminated")
```

### Check for Temperature Values Outside Physiological Range

```{r check-temp-range}
# Check for values < 36°C or > 38°C
temp_outliers <- cbt %>%
  filter(cbt < 36 | cbt > 38) %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    n_below_36 = sum(cbt < 36),
    n_above_38 = sum(cbt > 38),
    n_total = n(),
    min_temp = min(cbt),
    max_temp = max(cbt),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Display results
if(nrow(temp_outliers) > 0) {
  temp_outliers %>%
    kable(
      col.names = c("ID", "Session", "n < 36°C", "n > 38°C", 
                    "Total", "Min", "Max"),
      caption = "Temperature Values Outside 36-38°C Range",
      digits = 2
    )
} else {
  knitr::kable(data.frame(Message = "✓ All temperature values within 36-38°C range"))
}
```

### Remove Physiologically Implausible Temperature Values

```{r remove-outliers}
# Count before removal
n_before <- nrow(cbt)
print(n_before)
n_outliers <- sum(cbt$cbt < 36 | cbt$cbt > 38, na.rm = TRUE)
print(n_outliers)

# Remove values outside 36-38°C range
cbt <- cbt %>%
  filter(cbt >= 36 & cbt <= 38)
```

### Identify Sudden Temperature Jumps (≥0.5°C between consecutive minutes)

```{r identify-jumps}
# Calculate temperature difference between consecutive measurements
cbt_jumps <- cbt %>%
  arrange(id, session, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_diff = cbt - lag(cbt),
    abs_temp_diff = abs(temp_diff),
    is_jump = abs_temp_diff >= 0.5
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summary of jumps
jump_summary <- cbt_jumps %>%
  filter(is_jump == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    n_jumps = n(),
    max_jump = max(abs_temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_jump = mean(abs_temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Display results
jump_summary %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("ID", "Session", "n Jumps", "Max Jump (°C)", "Mean Jump (°C)"),
    caption = paste0("Temperature Jumps ≥0.5°C Between Consecutive Minutes (n=", 
                     nrow(jump_summary), " sessions affected)"),
    digits = 2
  )

# Overall summary
total_jumps <- sum(cbt_jumps$is_jump, na.rm = TRUE)
total_measurements <- nrow(cbt_jumps)

data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total measurements", "Jumps detected", "% affected"),
  Value = c(
    format(total_measurements, big.mark = ","),
    format(total_jumps, big.mark = ","),
    paste0(round(total_jumps/total_measurements * 100, 3), "%")
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Overall Summary of Temperature Jumps")
```

### Remove Temperature Jumps (≥0.5°C between consecutive minutes)

```{r remove-jumps}
# Count before removal
n_before <- nrow(cbt)

# Calculate jumps and mark for removal
cbt <- cbt %>%
  arrange(id, session, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_diff = abs(cbt - lag(cbt)),
    remove = !is.na(temp_diff) & temp_diff >= 0.5
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!remove) %>%
  select(-temp_diff, -remove)

# Count after removal
n_after <- nrow(cbt)
n_removed <- n_before - n_after

# Summary
data.frame(
  Metric = c("Measurements before", "Jumps removed", "Measurements after", "% removed"),
  Value = c(
    format(n_before, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_removed, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_after, big.mark = ","),
    paste0(round(n_removed/n_before * 100, 3), "%")
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Data Cleaning: Removal of Temperature Jumps (≥0.5°C between consecutive minutes)")

print(cbt)
```

### Add 30-Minute Block Means to Dataset

```{r add-thirty-min-blocks}
# Calculate 30-minute block means and add to original dataset
cbt <- cbt %>%
  mutate(
    time = paste0(substr(timestamp, 10, 11), ":", substr(timestamp, 12, 13)),
    group = case_when(
      id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      id %in% c("P10") ~ 4
    ),
    # Assign time blocks based on group
    time_block = case_when(
      # Group 1: 18:30-23:30
      group == 1 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "21:30" & time < "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "22:00" & time < "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "22:30" & time < "23:00" ~ "22:30-23:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "23:00" & time <= "23:30" ~ "23:00-23:30",
      
      # Group 2: 16:30-21:30
      group == 2 & time >= "16:30" & time < "17:00" ~ "16:30-17:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "17:00" & time < "17:30" ~ "17:00-17:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "17:30" & time < "18:00" ~ "17:30-18:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "21:00" & time <= "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      
      # Group 3: 18:00-23:00
      group == 3 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "21:30" & time < "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "22:00" & time < "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "22:30" & time <= "23:00" ~ "22:30-23:00",
      
      # Group 4: 17:30-22:30
      group == 4 & time >= "17:30" & time < "18:00" ~ "17:30-18:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "21:30" & time <= "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "22:00" & time <= "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, session, time_block) %>%
  mutate(cbt_30min = mean(cbt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r cbt-timecourse-all-participants}
#| label: fig-cbt-all-participants
#| fig-cap: "Core Body Temperature per evening - all participants"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Define participant information
participant_info <- list(
  P01 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P02 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P03 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P04 = list(hbt = 22, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 2),
  P05 = list(hbt = 22, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 2),
  P06 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P07 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P09 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P10 = list(hbt = 23, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", NA, "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D"), group = 4)
)

# Function to create plot for one participant
create_cbt_plot <- function(participant_id, info) {
  
  # Prepare data
  cbt_plot <- cbt %>%
    filter(id == participant_id) %>%
    filter(!(participant_id == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
    mutate(
      session_num = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3)),
      light_condition = info$light_pattern[session_num]
    ) %>%
    group_by(session_num, time_block) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      start_hour = as.numeric(substr(time_block, 1, 2)),
      start_min = as.numeric(substr(time_block, 4, 5)),
      time_decimal_mid = start_hour + start_min/60 + 0.25,
      hours_before_hbt = case_when(
        info$hbt == 0 ~ 24 - time_decimal_mid,
        info$hbt == 22 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 16.5, 22 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        info$hbt == 23 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 17.5, 23 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        info$hbt == 23.5 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 18, 23.5 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(hours_before_hbt >= 0.5 & hours_before_hbt <= 5.5) %>%
    arrange(session_num, hours_before_hbt)
  
  if(nrow(cbt_plot) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data available for", participant_id))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Determine y-axis limits
  y_min <- floor(min(cbt_plot$cbt_30min, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(cbt_plot$cbt_30min, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  # X-axis labels with HBT times (odd blocks only)
  x_labels <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)",
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(cbt_plot, aes(x = hours_before_hbt, y = cbt_30min)) +
    
    # Only yellow background for B evenings, no background for D evenings
    geom_rect(data = subset(cbt_plot, light_condition == "B") %>%
                group_by(session_num) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup(),
              aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = c(5.25, 4.75, 4.25, 3.75, 3.25, 2.75, 2.25, 1.75, 1.25, 0.75),
      labels = x_labels,
      limits = c(5.5, 0.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_min, y_max),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ session_num, ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(session_num = function(x) {
                 sapply(x, function(session) {
                   session_num <- as.numeric(session)
                   light_label <- if(session_num <= length(info$light_pattern) &&
                                    !is.na(info$light_pattern[session_num])) {
                     info$light_pattern[session_num]
                   } else {
                     "?"
                   }
                   paste0("Evening ", session, " (", light_label, ")")
                 })
               })) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste0("Core Body Temperature per evening (", participant_id, ")"),
      x = "Block number (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Core Body Temperature [°C]"
    ) +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for all participants
for (pid in names(participant_info)) {
  plot <- create_cbt_plot(pid, participant_info[[pid]])
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    print(plot)
  }
}
```

```{r add-cbt-entire-and-intervention}
# Calculate cbt_entire (entire 5h exposure window) and cbt_intervention (intervention window only)
cbt <- cbt %>%
  mutate(
    # Define exposure windows based on group
    in_entire_window = case_when(
      # Group 1: 18:30-23:30 (5h)
      group == 1 & time >= "18:30" & time <= "23:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 2: 16:30-21:30 (5h)
      group == 2 & time >= "16:30" & time <= "21:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 3: 18:00-23:00 (5h)
      group == 3 & time >= "18:00" & time <= "23:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 4: 17:30-22:30 (5h)
      group == 4 & time >= "17:30" & time <= "22:30" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    # Define intervention windows based on group (start 3h after chamber entry, end 1h before HBT)
    in_intervention_window = case_when(
      # Group 1: 21:30-23:00 (1.5h)
      group == 1 & time >= "21:30" & time <= "23:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 2: 19:30-21:00 (1.5h)
      group == 2 & time >= "19:30" & time <= "21:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 3: 21:00-22:30 (1.5h)
      group == 3 & time >= "21:00" & time <= "22:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 4: 20:30-22:00 (1.5h)
      group == 4 & time >= "20:30" & time <= "22:00" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  # Calculate means per session
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  mutate(
    cbt_entire = mean(cbt[in_entire_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    cbt_intervention = mean(cbt[in_intervention_window], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove helper variables
  select(-in_entire_window, -in_intervention_window)
```

```{r cbt-doublet-setup}
# Define light patterns for groups 
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Create doublet dataframes
df_doublets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g1),
  doublet = paste0(light_g1[-length(light_g1)], light_g1[-1])
)

df_doublets_g2 <- data.frame(

)

df_doublets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g4_orig),

# Filter out doublets containing X (excluded session)
```

```{r cbt-doublet-preparation}
# Calculate doublet CBT for all participants - ENTIRE 5H WINDOW
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

df_plot_cbt <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cbt = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CBT data (one row per session with cbt_entire)
  cbt_data <- cbt %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    # Exclude P10 session 5
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
    select(exp_session, cbt_entire)
  
  # Join with doublets
  cbt_doublets <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cbt_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_cbt_doublets <- cbt_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cbt = mean(cbt_entire, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cbt_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_cbt <- rbind(df_plot_cbt, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cbt = mean_cbt_doublets$mean_cbt[mean_cbt_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_cbt$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cbt$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

```{r cbt-doublet-intervention-preparation}
# Calculate doublet CBT for all participants - INTERVENTION WINDOW (1.5h)
participants_int <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

df_plot_cbt_int <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cbt_int = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants_int) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CBT intervention data (one row per session with cbt_intervention)
  cbt_data_int <- cbt %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    # Exclude P10 session 5
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
    select(exp_session, cbt_intervention)
  
  # Join with doublets
  cbt_doublets_int <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cbt_data_int, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_cbt_doublets_int <- cbt_doublets_int %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cbt_int = mean(cbt_intervention, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cbt_doublets_int$doublet) {
      df_plot_cbt_int <- rbind(df_plot_cbt_int, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cbt_int = mean_cbt_doublets_int$mean_cbt_int[mean_cbt_doublets_int$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_cbt_int$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cbt_int$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

```{r cbt-doublet-position-setup}
# Create doublet position mappings (if not already created)
doublet_positions_g1 <- df_doublets_g1 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g2 <- df_doublets_g2 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g4 <- df_doublets_g4 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to calculate doublet positions for CBT (entire window)
calc_doublet_positions_cbt <- function(participant_id, cbt_data, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cbt = mean(cbt_data$cbt_entire[cbt_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cbt = mean(cbt_data$cbt_entire[cbt_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cbt, pos2_cbt)
  
  return(results)
}

# Function for intervention window
calc_doublet_positions_cbt_int <- function(participant_id, cbt_data_int, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cbt_int = mean(cbt_data_int$cbt_intervention[cbt_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cbt_int = mean(cbt_data_int$cbt_intervention[cbt_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cbt_int, pos2_cbt_int)
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r cbt-doublet-lineplot-5h}
# Calculate position data for all participants (excluding P07) - 5H WINDOW
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

mean_doublet_pos_cbt_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cbt = numeric(),
  sd_cbt = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(d in doublets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g2
      } else {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get CBT data
      cbt_data <- cbt %>%
        filter(id == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
        group_by(session) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
        select(exp_session, cbt_entire)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_cbt <- calc_doublet_positions_cbt(p, cbt_data, doublet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(d %in% pos_cbt$doublet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_cbt$pos1_cbt[pos_cbt$doublet == d])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_cbt$pos2_cbt[pos_cbt$doublet == d])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      mean_doublet_pos_cbt_noP07 <- rbind(mean_doublet_pos_cbt_noP07, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        position = pos,
        mean_cbt = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cbt = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_participants = length(values)
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_cbt_noP07 <- mean_doublet_pos_cbt_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = ifelse(position == "pos1", "Position 1", "Position 2"),
    position_num = ifelse(position == "pos1", 1, 2),
    light_type = ifelse(position == "pos1", 
                        substr(doublet, 1, 1),
                        substr(doublet, 2, 2)),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(doublet = factor(doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB")))

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("dim" = "#4A90E2", "bright" = "#F5A623")

# Create plot
ggplot(df_plot_positions_cbt_noP07, 
       aes(x = position_num, y = mean_cbt, group = doublet)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +

                     labels = c("dim" = "Dim (10 lx)", "bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), 
                     labels = c("Position 1", "Position 2"),
                     limits = c(0.8, 2.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Core body temperature across light exposure doublets",
    subtitle = "Mean CBT across all participants (5-h exposure; P07 excluded)",
    x = "Doublet position",
    y = "Mean Core Body Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),

    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r cbt-triplet-setup}
# Define light patterns for triplets
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Create triplet dataframes
df_triplets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g1),
  triplet = paste0(light_g1[1:(length(light_g1) - 2)], 
                   light_g1[2:(length(light_g1) - 1)], 
                   light_g1[3:length(light_g1)])
)

df_triplets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g2) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g2) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g2),
  triplet = paste0(light_g2[1:(length(light_g2) - 2)], 
                   light_g2[2:(length(light_g2) - 1)], 
                   light_g2[3:length(light_g2)])
)

df_triplets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
  triplet = paste0(light_g4_orig[1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2)], 
                   light_g4_orig[2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1)], 
                   light_g4_orig[3:length(light_g4_orig)])
)

# Filter out triplets containing X (excluded session 5 for P10)
df_triplets_g4 <- df_triplets_g4_orig %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X"))

# Create triplet position mappings
triplet_positions_g1 <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g2 <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g4 <- df_triplets_g4 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Functions to calculate triplet positions for CBT
calc_triplet_positions_cbt <- function(participant_id, cbt_data, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cbt = mean(cbt_data$cbt_entire[cbt_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cbt = mean(cbt_data$cbt_entire[cbt_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cbt = mean(cbt_data$cbt_entire[cbt_data$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cbt, pos2_cbt, pos3_cbt)
  
  return(results)
}

calc_triplet_positions_cbt_int <- function(participant_id, cbt_data_int, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cbt_int = mean(cbt_data_int$cbt_intervention[cbt_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cbt_int = mean(cbt_data_int$cbt_intervention[cbt_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cbt_int = mean(cbt_data_int$cbt_intervention[cbt_data_int$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cbt_int, pos2_cbt_int, pos3_cbt_int)
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r cbt-triplet-boxplot-5h-preparation}
# Calculate triplet CBT for all participants - ENTIRE 5H WINDOW
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
triplets <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

df_plot_cbt_triplet <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cbt = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate triplet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CBT data
  cbt_data <- cbt %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
    select(exp_session, cbt_entire)
  
  # Join with triplets
  cbt_triplets <- df_triplets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cbt_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per triplet
  mean_cbt_triplets <- cbt_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cbt = mean(cbt_entire, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cbt_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_cbt_triplet <- rbind(df_plot_cbt_triplet, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cbt = mean_cbt_triplets$mean_cbt[mean_cbt_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_cbt_triplet$triplet <- factor(df_plot_cbt_triplet$triplet, 
                                      levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD",
```

```{r cbt-triplet-boxplot-1.5h-preparation}
# Calculate triplet CBT for all participants - INTERVENTION WINDOW (1.5h)
participants_int <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

df_plot_cbt_triplet_int <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cbt_int = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants_int) {
  # Select appropriate triplet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CBT intervention data
  cbt_data_int <- cbt %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
    select(exp_session, cbt_intervention)
  
  # Join with triplets
  cbt_triplets_int <- df_triplets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cbt_data_int, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per triplet
  mean_cbt_triplets_int <- cbt_triplets_int %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cbt_int = mean(cbt_intervention, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cbt_triplets_int$triplet) {
      df_plot_cbt_triplet_int <- rbind(df_plot_cbt_triplet_int, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cbt_int = mean_cbt_triplets_int$mean_cbt_int[mean_cbt_triplets_int$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_cbt_triplet_int$triplet <- factor(df_plot_cbt_triplet_int$triplet, 
                                          levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                                    "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))
```

```{r cbt-triplet-lineplot-5h}
# Calculate position data for all participants (excluding P07) - 5H WINDOW
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

mean_triplet_pos_cbt_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cbt = numeric(),
  sd_cbt = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(t in triplets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2", "pos3")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
      } else {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get CBT data
      cbt_data <- cbt %>%
        filter(id == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "105")) %>%
        group_by(session) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(substr(session, 2, 3))) %>%
        select(exp_session, cbt_entire)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_cbt <- calc_triplet_positions_cbt(p, cbt_data, triplet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(t %in% pos_cbt$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_cbt$pos1_cbt[pos_cbt$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values <- c(values, pos_cbt$pos2_cbt[pos_cbt$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_cbt$pos3_cbt[pos_cbt$triplet == t])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      mean_triplet_pos_cbt_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_cbt_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_cbt = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),

      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting

    ),
    position_num = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ 1,

      position == "pos3" ~ 3
    ),

  )
```

## CBT Triplet Time-Course Analysis

### Data Preparation

```{r cbt-triplet-timecourse-setup}
# Get session 3 data for each triplet 
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

# Function to get session 3 for each triplet type
get_triplet_session3 <- function(p, triplet_type) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- data.frame(
      session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) 
        paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_start != 5 & session_mid != 5 & session_end != 5)
  }
  
  sessions_3 <- df_triplets %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
    pull(session_end)
  
  return(sessions_3)
}

# Function to get all participant-session combinations for a triplet
get_triplet_sessions_overview <- function(triplet_type) {
  overview <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        overview <- rbind(overview, data.frame(
          participant_id = p,
          session = s
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(overview %>% arrange(session, participant_id))
}

# Function to get group ID from participant ID
get_group_id <- function(p) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) return(1)
  if(p %in% c("P04", "P05")) return(2)
  if(p %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09")) return(3)
  if(p == "P10") return(4)
  return(NA)
}

# Function to create CBT plot for one triplet type
plot_triplet_timecourse_cbt <- function(triplet_type) {
  df_triplet_cbt <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      group_id <- get_group_id(p)
      session_ids <- paste0(group_id, sprintf("%02d", sessions_3))
      
      p_data <- cbt %>%
        filter(id == p, session %in% session_ids) %>%
        select(id, session, time_block, cbt_30min) %>%
        filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
        group_by(session, time_block) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      df_triplet_cbt <- rbind(df_triplet_cbt, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(df_triplet_cbt) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for triplet", triplet_type))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_triplet_cbt <- df_triplet_cbt %>%
    group_by(id, session) %>%
    arrange(time_block) %>%
    mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  triplet_summary <- df_triplet_cbt %>%
    group_by(block_num) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cbt = mean(cbt_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cbt = sd(cbt_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  y_min <- floor(min(triplet_summary$mean_cbt - triplet_summary$sd_cbt, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary$mean_cbt + triplet_summary$sd_cbt, 
                       na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  third_letter <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  intervention_label <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "dim\n(10 lx)", "bright\n(1000 lx)")
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_type, 1, 2)
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  
  p <- ggplot(triplet_summary, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_cbt)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = y_max - 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - 0.03, label = intervention_label, 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
             color = ifelse(third_letter == "D", "grey50", "#B8860B"), 
             fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_cbt - sd_cbt,
                    ymax = mean_cbt + sd_cbt),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = c(
        "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
        "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
      ),
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote("Core body temperature time course - Triplet " * 
                     .(triplet_first_two) * bold(.(triplet_third))),
      subtitle = paste0("Grand average third-day (n=", 
                       length(unique(df_triplet_cbt$id)), 
                       " participants; P07 excluded)"),
      x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Mean core body temperature (°C)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 5)),  
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)), 
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```
